title: Canonical well-formed oracle tables
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$, define the type of canonical tables to consist of Boolean oracle Turing machines with $k$ ordinary work tapes and state set $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, equipped with a proof that their query, positive-answer, and negative-answer states are pairwise distinct.
